research_question: Do the metric-dependent dimension ranking and market-direction mechanism survive replacement of the legacy public Core-92 input by the fully lineage-audited Core-86 production input?
frozen_assets_and_metrics: Use exactly the 25 size-book-to-market, 49 industry, combined 74, and V021 six external families; use exactly the V015-V021 geometry, moment, alpha, market-hedge, and K=1 plus Mkt-RF estimands.

primary_rules.geometry: The combined 74 portfolios select different five-seed-mean best K at gamma 0 and gamma 1, and the 12-month block-bootstrap 95% interval for A=[D_K1(0)-D_K5(0)]-[D_K1(1)-D_K5(1)] lies above zero.
primary_rules.external_transfer: At least four of the six frozen external families select different best K at the two endpoints.
primary_rules.market_mechanism: Validation-frozen market-beta hedging reduces abs(A) for the combined 74 point estimate and in at least four of six external families.
primary_rules.economic_completion: K=1 plus Mkt-RF lowers both raw Euler moments and mean absolute alpha relative to K=1 in at least four of six external families.

stopping_rule: This is a fixed data-lineage replication, not architecture search. Regardless of outcome, do not change features, dimensions, seeds, assets, metrics, hyperparameters, or reopen teacher selection. A failure narrows the claim and both legacy Core-92 and production Core-86 results must be reported.
